$comment: Labelled questions for retrieval evaluation. `must_contain` is a distinctive string
from the passage that actually answers the question — the cheapest usable ground
truth, and enough to compute recall@k without hand-judging every run.
The last two cases are ANSWERLESS on purpose. A retrieval eval made only of questions
the corpus answers cannot measure the failure that matters most in production: an
answer invented for a question nobody documented.

cases.question: how long are session transcripts kept?
what happens to transcripts with customer data?
when should I engage the global stop?
how many backup rotations do we keep?
when does a new engineer take their first on-call shift?
what is the threshold for investigating a spend jump?
what is our parental leave allowance?
which cloud region hosts the primary database?
